role: Marker interface for the spawn-pack state that onSpawnWithEgg passes along (the zombie's and spider's GroupData objects).
notes: Marker interface with no members. The native stand-in is struct sp_data in spawning.h ("The pack's IEntityLivingData"), carrying EntityZombie.GroupData's made/child/villager flags and EntitySpider.GroupData's spider_made/spider_potion; onSpawnWithEgg's return-value threading (the spider jockey) is handled by living.c's living_on_spawn_with_egg_ret instead. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): interface, marker or abstract base; its behavior lives in the subclasses' ports.
